_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): LLM chat vertical slice — OpenAI-compatible streaming client (httpx), per-user usage tracking, SSE endpoint. Pairs with feature-sse patterns and feature-auth.
name: feature-llm
description: AI chat backend: OpenAI-compatible streaming client + per-user usage table + SSE /chat endpoint and /usage summary. Works with DeepSeek/OpenRouter/any OpenAI-style gateway.

variables.name: llm_base_url
variables.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL (no trailing /v1 needed for DeepSeek)

variables.name: llm_model
variables.description: Default model id sent with each request

variables.name: secret_env
variables.description: Env var name holding the API key

notes: After applying: 1) set {{ secret_env }} in .env, 2) import services.llm_service in main.py so llm_usage table is created (LLMUsage lives in llm_service — move to models/ if you prefer), 3) app.include_router(router), 4) frontend pairs with comp-chat (SSE consumption) and comp-markdown-viewer, 5) add quotas via llm_service before chat(). Requires httpx in requirements.
